slice3DesignProposal.foundationBoundary: Slice 2 committed evidence is not operational coordinator completion. Existing foundation-only events cannot be silently upgraded or replayed as operational success.
slice3DesignProposal.authority: Keep private objects inaccessible to application roles. Future public wrappers derive authenticated actor context and authorize before business locks; never trust a caller-supplied actor as public authority.
slice3DesignProposal.evidence: Separate immutable coordinator completion and actual-tender movement evidence linked to one exact original collection/full reversal event, payment, order, actor, event time, amount, tender, reference and current Cash Shift. Existing immutable foundation result is not rewritten.
slice3DesignProposal.cashCliq: Original collection tender and actual reversal tender are independent. Cash reversal requires a current open Shift; CliQ requires durable reference and no artificial Cash movement. Closed original Shift snapshots remain immutable.
slice3DesignProposal.collectionBoundary: A Slice 2 collection anchors an already-authoritative public payment. It is not permission to create a second payment or duplicate its inflow. New collection creation and existing-source anchoring must have explicit distinct roles before activation.
slice3DesignProposal.exactSet: Derive expected evidence from immutable operation/request/source-payment anchors, validate per-identity bidirectional equality across all coordinator-owned records, and use one central validator for finalization and replay. No aggregate-only proof or evidence-self-derived truth.
slice3DesignProposal.transaction: Fresh coordinator completion and all required foundation/movement evidence commit together; any missing, contradictory or extra evidence rejects atomically. No backfill/adoption of incomplete historical operations.
slice3DesignProposal.lockDesign: Pre-acquire all exact idempotency gates before the existing phase4-order/current-Shift/Order/source-payment business lock domain. Reuse the existing helper; do not introduce an earlier-ranked gate after business locks. Freeze relevant Shift identities and revalidate after locking; discovery changes require rollback/safe retry.
slice3DesignProposal.replay: Actor/key/fingerprint and exact original request must match. Validate complete durable operational evidence before stored success; valid committed replay precedes fresh Shift/eligibility checks and writes nothing.

S4-DG1.boundary: Total graph discovery shared by facts, position and reconciliation
S4-DG1.discovery: Seed authoritative modern Order/creation/completion and all payments plus typed request/result Order identities, declared Order columns and reverse operation/event/payment/header/item/movement/completion edges. Expand to a fixed point before lifecycle classification; disconnected request-only operations and contradictory links cannot disappear through child/settled joins.
S4-DG1.coverage: Require bidirectional exact tuple coverage and cardinality per authoritative identity across financial operations, collections, reversals, tender movements/completions and operational Return evidence. Classify valid drafts as zero settled money only when no committed final/effect evidence exists; incomplete financial/foundation-only reversal evidence rejects.
S4-DG1.unassignable: Bounded relevant-node integrity check rejects malformed evidence with no usable Order identity or resolvable link as UNASSIGNABLE_EVIDENCE. Do not guess ownership or claim a per-Order child query can discover it. Valid unrelated assignable graphs are not rejected due to another Order's incomplete evidence.
S4-DG1.runtimeRequired: Real private reads with disconnected operations, orphan completion/movement/effect, contradictory Order links and identity substitution must reject with zero content mutation.

S4-DG2.domain: Exact integer minor units, checked result range, non-null typed amounts and identities, immutable original T/L, nonnegative validated event amounts and full per-source reversal limits. No floating point, NULL/UNKNOWN acceptance or guessed zero.
S4-DG2.currentPredicates: X=C-V >= 0; D+R <= T-L; X+D <= T; O=T-X-D; DO=min(L,O); CD=L-DO; R <= X-CD, after independent per-identity evidence validation. Gross C may exceed T after legitimate full reversal/recollection; never subtract refund from coverage or recreate debt.
S4-DG2.historicalReturn: E_i=D_i+R_i; D_i=min(E_i,B_i); R_i=E_i-D_i <= N_i. Migration121 actually stores merchandise debt B_i and refundable collected N_i in the generic-named before snapshots. Do not subtract delivery/refunds again or recompute historical debt-first allocation from current state; require immutable item/evidence/result binding.
S4-DG2.tender: Use actual Cash/CliQ movement methods, preserve historical Return Shift requirements separately from CliQ-reversal rules, and require Cash+CliQ net flow equals X-R. Negative cross-tender Cash flow is valid, negative event amounts/capacity are not.
S4-DG2.runtimeRequired: Valid recollection/debt-only/mixed/delivery/cross-tender cases and invalid over-allocation, refund backing, SQL/JSON NULL, overflow and same-total identity substitution.

S4-DG3.entrypoints: All three proposed read entrypoints and new table-reading helpers are STABLE SQL/PLpgSQL, SECURITY INVOKER with fixed search paths; never default VOLATILE or table-dependent IMMUTABLE.
S4-DG3.callGraph: Exact-signature transitive source/catalog admission permits read-only STABLE validators and pure scalar helpers only. Exclude writers, coordinators, finalizers, anchoring, business/advisory row locks, sequences, network and dynamic mutation; the old amount_paid reader is diagnostic only, not canonical authority.
S4-DG3.visibility: One calling-query MVCC snapshot for discovery, validation, arithmetic and reconciliation. Standalone next READ COMMITTED SELECT may see new commits; multi-call comparisons use REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY. Statement/event timestamps are not commit or universal visibility cutoffs. No same-statement data-modifying-CTE consumer or capacity reservation is supplied.
S4-DG3.runtimeRequired: Pause discovery/derivation in an isolated harness, commit a valid concurrent mutation and prove old coherent first result, fresh next call, consistent reconciliation and zero read-owned mutation/gates.

S3-DG1.entrypoints: Distinguish existing-source collection anchoring, new collection creation, fresh exact-payment reversal and committed replay. Slice 3 reversal must reuse existing validated original collection evidence, never create an original collection as an implicit side effect.
S3-DG1.discovery: Before writes, freeze the branch, Order, actor, customer, exact source payments/collections, current Cash Shift when needed and every Shift referenced by rows actually being inserted. A historical Shift read is not automatically an FK write dependency; collection anchoring to a historical Cash Shift is one.
S3-DG1.acquisition: Authorize first; acquire exact operation idempotency gates, then phase4-order gate. Acquire required Shift rows in UUID order before the Order/payment/collection rows. Current Cash Shift uses FOR UPDATE; historical FK-only Shift uses FOR KEY SHARE. For a shared identity use the strongest required mode up front, never upgrade later. Acquire planned remaining FK parent key locks before the first evidence INSERT.
S3-DG1.contention: Use NOWAIT for preplanned business/FK row acquisition so a full-Shift reversal holding Shift/order resources cannot create a blocking inverse cycle. Contention is an explicit rollback/retry outcome, not success or a masked timeout. Replay remains read-only and does not take these business locks.
S3-DG1.freshValidation: After locking, reread all identities/statuses and compare the plan. Any new Shift, branch/source relationship or missing lock means rollback/safe retry, never late discovery/acquisition. No client-visible result is committed before validation.
S3-DG1.legacyHelperBoundary: The current Migration 120 helper discovers/locks only one current Shift and therefore is not sufficient for multi-Shift FK plans. Future additive private prelocked routines must reuse the established root domain and Slice 2 evidence/identity validation while consuming the frozen plan. They must not call the old blocking discovery helper after later locks, including the CliQ/no-open-Shift case where a new Shift could appear.
S3-DG1.proofRequired: Real independent-session tests for historical A/current B versus full reversal of A and B, inverse UUID ordering, Shift close/open during discovery, no-open CliQ, FK parent contention and post-lock relationship changes. Measure deadlock delta and prove loser content-sensitive zero footprint; no static measured-deadlock claim.

S3-DG2.population: Build an exact disjoint per-Order source population from validated modern sale/completion facts and exact public customer_payments. Reject unsupported tenders, ambiguous legacy evidence, unrepresented payments and contradictory source bindings rather than infer truth from orders.amount_paid or an incomplete private SUM.
S3-DG2.initialCollections: Migration 115 POS stores original net collection in its immutable business-operation result without inserting a customer_payments row. Migration 116 Customer completion can either store a full initial collection without a payment row, or reference a partial collection by customer_payment_number. A partial completion linked to that exact payment contributes once through the payment source, not again through the completion result. Full initial modern collection is a distinct source fact, not a fabricated customer payment and not an extra reversible payment under this slice.
S3-DG2.sourceIdentity: Use typed source identity: validated original modern sale/completion operation versus exact original customer_payment_id. Revalidate original operation/request/result/order bindings; resolve Customer partial payment_number to its unique payment and verify order/amount/tender/actor relationship. Missing or contradictory anchors are unsupported/fail-closed.
S3-DG2.foundationAuthority: Slice 2 collection evidence may describe an already-committed authoritative source payment and is not a second inflow. All prior private reversal events used in operational coverage require exact validated coordinator completion and movement evidence. A foundation-only prior reversal makes the Order population ineligible; do not ignore it or adopt it as an operational outflow.
S3-DG2.candidate: Before writes, validate the full source population and every prior operational reversal/settled Return. Compute tender-independent coverage from distinct committed source collections minus validated operational reversals, then subtract the one exact candidate payment. Preserve the approved debt/refund/delivery equations; monetary refunds constrain reversible capacity and are not subtracted twice or used to recreate debt.
S3-DG2.writerBoundary: Migration 124 SUM-only capacity is insufficient for this expanded population. Future additive coordinator/prelocked writer logic must calculate candidate capacity from the complete typed source set instead of blindly delegating capacity to the closed Slice 2 helper. Original Slice 2 implementation stays unchanged/private. Public writer and financial reader convergence remains a separate activation prerequisite.
S3-DG2.proofRequired: 70+30 with full reversal of exact payment 30; paid POS initial collection plus later payment; full Customer initial collection; partial Customer completion linked to payment counted once; missing canonical source; foundation-only prior reversal; duplicate typed sources; cross-Order matching amount; legacy ambiguity; candidate after settled Return. No new reversal of an implicit initial collection is introduced.

S3-DG3.identity: Historical collection is identified by its original source event/payment, not by the later anchor operation. Anchoring does not create another economic movement, another drawer inflow or coordinator issuance success.
S3-DG3.times: Keep immutable source_recorded_at and source Shift distinct from evidence_recorded_at and fresh reversal_executed_at. For a customer payment source_recorded_at is its original created_at; for validated modern POS/Customer initial collection use the original operation's recorded server event time. These are repository event timestamps, not claimed bank settlement or wall-clock commit times.
S3-DG3.reversal: Capture reversal_executed_at after locks and candidate validation; bind the reversal movement, foundation reversal operation and coordinator completion to the same server event. Cash outflow belongs to the exact current open Shift; CliQ uses actual committed channel/reference and no Cash Shift.
S3-DG3.readers: Future tender reports attribute original inflow once to its original source/Shift/recorded period, and reversal once to its actual reversal tender/Shift/execution period. Evidence anchoring time is audit metadata only. Closed original Shift snapshots are not rewritten. Replay returns stored timestamps unchanged.
S3-DG3.proofRequired: Original collection in period/Shift A, anchor in B, Cash reversal in C; no new inflow in B, one outflow in C; cross-tender case; timestamp/Shift corruption; session TimeZone equivalence; replay after Shift closure. Insufficient historical time/identity evidence rejects without guessing.
